arguments.message:
Hi there – Meridian will never ask you to wire money to a new bank account via email. Any email that requests an urgent wire transfer or payment outside of the methods set up in your account’s Billing settings is not a legitimate Meridian request. 

Please do not reply, click any links, or make a payment. Instead, compare the invoice details with what you see in Settings → Billing in your account, and forward the suspicious email to our support team so we can verify it against your actual billing record.

If you have any other questions, let us know!
